rows.label: LORE
rows.clue: Knowledge gained through tradition or anecdote

rows.label: BAIT
rows.clue: Anything that serves as an enticement

rows.label: PARTIAL
rows.clue: The derivative of a function of two or more variables with respect to a single variable while the other variables are considered to be constant

rows.label: LEARNING
rows.clue: The cognitive process of acquiring skill or knowledge

rows.label: KNOWING
rows.clue: A clear and certain mental apprehension

rows.label: ENHANCER
rows.clue: Anything that serves by contrast to call attention to another thing's good qualities

rows.label: POWER LAW
rows.clue: (psychophysics) the concept that the magnitude of a subjective sensation increases proportional to a power of the stimulus intensity
